nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit, detects changed code files via git diff HEAD~1 and re-runs AST extraction only; doc/image changes are ignored by the hook and need a manual /graphify --update; it appends to an existing post-commit hook rather than replacing it.

nodes.label: Native CLAUDE.md Integration
nodes.rationale: graphify claude install writes a ## graphify section into the project's CLAUDE.md instructing Claude to check the graph before answering codebase questions and rebuild it after code changes, so no manual /graphify invocation is needed in future sessions.
